parsed.explanation: No trans-specific criminal offence and no sodomy law, so there is no statutory predicate for prosecution, and asylum SOPs explicitly name transgender people as protected. But the heaviest documented feature is state-tolerated targeting: a 2025 UN submission records police harassment during identity checks and arbitrary arrests under vagrancy/public-order grounds, plus violent detentions (2020) — the state is the perpetrator, with no complaint remedy or non-discrimination claim available to a visitor. Social stigma, official non-engagement and unregistrable LGBT organisations corroborate thin recourse; no killings or custody violence pattern are documented. This sits with the police-stop/arbitrary-arrest tier: above the 0.25 raid/extortion profiles, below universal-exposure jurisdictions. Border screening and facility placement remain open questions, not counted as exposures.
